mod.name: Auto Loot Plus
mod.summary: Auto loot in a radius you set. Stand-in summary written for EMF's tests.
mod.author: Dellemann
mod.description:
[size=5][b]Auto Loot Plus[/b][/size]
[i]Stand-in text written for EMF's tests; the mod's own description is on its Nexus page.[/i]

[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
Picks up loot around you. This paragraph is only here to be converted.

[size=4][b]New in 1.1.8[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Fixed: a thing.[/b] A few words about it.[/*]
[*][b]Keys:[/b] menuKey (F8) and autoLootKey (F9) in config.txt, "quoted".[/*]
[*]A plain item.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]New in 1.1.7[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]A bold start[/b] (F8 menu › Smashing) and more.[/*]
[*][color=#ffa500]A coloured warning[/color] – and the rest of the line.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]New in 1.1.0[/b][/size]
[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]One fix.[/*]
[/list][b]New features[/b]
[list]
[*][b]A feature[/b] – after a dash[/*]
[*]A link in an item: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/enshrouded/mods/204]Auto Loot Plus Filter Companion[/url][/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Enshrouded 1.0 (Steam, Windows)[/*]
[*][url=https://github.com/brabb3l/kfc-parser/releases]Enshrouded Mod Loader (EML)[/url] – the [b]dbghelp.dll[/b] version.[/*]
[/list][color=#ffa500][b]Important:[/b][/color] use EML's [b]dbghelp.dll[/b].

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Open the game folder.[/*]
[*]Unpack this archive there. Afterwards it holds:
[code]enshrouded.exe
dbghelp.dll (EML)
dinput8.dll (Auto Loot Plus)
mods\auto-loot-plus\ (mod.json, config.txt, src\)[/code][/*]
[*]Start the game and press [b]F8[/b].[/*]
[/list]
[b]Other dinput8.dll mods:[/b] list them in [b]dinput8-chain.ini[/b]:
[code][Chain]
atlas.dll[/code]One file name per line.

[b]Uninstall:[/b] delete dinput8.dll and mods\auto-loot-plus.
[color=#ff6666][b]Warning:[/b][/color] a coloured, bold warning.

[size=4][b]Good to know[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Back up your save[/b]: Steam\userdata\<your id>\1203620\remote[/*]
[*]The log must have a line starting with
[code][Auto Loot Plus] v1.1.8[/code]. If it does not, EML did not load the mod.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Credits[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][url=https://github.com/ocornut/imgui]Dear ImGui[/url] for the menu (MIT)[/*]
[/list]
[spoiler]
[size=4][b]Deutsch[/b][/size]
Platzhaltertext für die Tests von EMF: „Größere Stapel“, Bäume, Glühwürmchen.
[b]Filter:[/b] siehe [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/enshrouded/mods/204]Auto Loot Plus Filter Companion[/url].
[b]Deinstallieren:[/b] dinput8.dll und mods\auto-loot-plus löschen.
[color=#ff6666][b]Warnung:[/b][/color] eine farbige Warnung.[/spoiler]
